name: draft_reply_on_correct_thread_same_subject_two_customers
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Alice's complaint thread and Diana's thread share the subject 'Unauthorized charge inquiry'. The reply about Target TX17 must go on Alice's thread to Alice, not Diana's.
tests: passes when a draft is created on th_c01_complaint to alice.smith@example.com and not on th_c04_distractor.
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Two customers have emails with the subject 'Unauthorized charge inquiry'. Ask the assistant to find the one from Alice Smith about the Target charge and draft her a reply confirming we have her correction (Target, not Whole Foods) and will proceed with that charge once she confirms in chat. Make sure it goes to Alice, not the other customer.

Your details:
- Recipient: alice.smith@example.com
- Subject: Unauthorized charge inquiry - Card ending in 4821

persona.name: Ben Carter
persona.initial_message: There are two 'Unauthorized charge inquiry' threads. Please draft a reply to Alice Smith's one, about the Target charge, for review.

arguments.subject: Re: Unauthorized charge inquiry - Card ending in 4821
arguments.body: Dear Alice Smith, thank you for the correction: we note the charge in question is Target Store #1042 for $84.20 on October 24 (TX17), not Whole Foods. Once you confirm with us in chat we will lock the card if you wish and open the dispute for TX17.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: msg_003, a message of the customer's thread
